brief.headline: Database Guardian could not produce a grounded proposal
brief.what_broke: 12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 120785 (batch_worker/adhoc_reporting, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s); last statement: SELECT 1
brief.who_is_affected: Checkout success 74% over 10s (8/31 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,748/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

options.description: Terminate the root blocker session (batch_worker/adhoc_reporting, pid 120785) to release its locks.
Take no action; let the blocker finish and monitor checkout recovery.
options.cost: about $4,748/min of checkout revenue at risk while waiting

audit.report: Checkout degraded after an unknown workload acquired a database lock, with success dropping from 74% to 0% during the incident. The Database Guardian could not produce a grounded proposal and failed grounding twice, so the incident was escalated to on-call after one round lasting 12.4 seconds. No recovery action was executed. At the time of the last evidence, checkout success was 53% over 15 seconds with 28 timeouts, and about $4,748 per minute was at risk against an SLO of 95%. The business was not recovered within the trace.
audit.root_cause: An idle-in-transaction batch_worker/adhoc_reporting session (pid 120785) held a database lock for 4.0 seconds, blocking checkout sessions and degrading success below SLO.
lessons: For batch_worker/adhoc_reporting, pre-register known long-running or idle-in-transaction sessions in the runbook so the Database Guardian can identify and ground a kill or cancel proposal immediately.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian wasted the single negotiation round by failing to ground a proposal from the available blocker evidence, and the Continuity Guardian did not override with a safe default such as terminating the idle blocker.
follow_ups: Terminate pid 120785 and confirm checkout success returns to at least 95%.
Add the batch_worker/adhoc_reporting blocker pattern to the Database Guardian grounding checklist.
Review why the unknown workload held the lock idle in transaction for 4.0 seconds.

data.story: An ad-hoc reporting session no system of record knows about holds the lock. Nobody can establish what killing it would cost.
